title: J041--Service - AHU PM & Filter Evaluation -  NWI
agency: VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF > VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF > NETWORK CONTRACT OFFICE 23 (36C263)
description:
SOURCES SOUGHT NOTICE
Omaha and Grand Island VAMC - HVAC Preventive Maintenance and Filter Evaluation
NAICS: 238220 - PSC: J041 - Small Business Size Standard: $19 million
NOTICE PURPOSE
The Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Network Contracting Office (NCO) 23, is conducting market research to identify businesses capable of providing HVAC preventive maintenance and filter evaluation services at the Omaha and Grand Island VA Medical Centers. This is a sources sought notice only and is not a solicitation or request for quotations. No award will be made from responses, and the Government will not reimburse response costs.
GENERAL REQUIREMENT
The anticipated requirement includes:
Preventive maintenance and inspections of air handling units (AHUs) and rooftop units (RTUs).
HVAC equipment and coil cleaning.
Air filter inspections and evaluations.
Airflow and system performance testing.
Humidifier inspection and maintenance.
HEPA/MERV filter evaluation and applicable replacement work.
Written reports documenting inspections, maintenance, and deficiencies.
Services are anticipated for a base year with option years. The detailed requirements will be provided in any resulting solicitation.
PLACE OF PERFORMANCE
Omaha VA Medical Center, 4101 Woolworth Avenue, Omaha, NE 68105
Grand Island VA Medical Center, 2201 N Broadwell Avenue, Grand Island, NE 68803
INFORMATION REQUESTED
Company name, address, UEI, and point of contact with phone number and email.
Business size and socioeconomic status, including SBA-certified SDVOSB or VOSB status.
Confirmation that the company can perform the services described above at both locations.
Brief description of similar HVAC preventive maintenance experience.
Whether services would be performed by company employees, subcontractors, or both.
RESPONSE INSTRUCTIONS
Email responses no later than Monday, November 30, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. Central Time to amanda.patterson-elliott@va.gov. Use "Omaha and Grand Island HVAC PM Sources Sought" in the subject line. NO PHONE CALL, PLEASE. 
Responses are for market research purposes only and do not constitute offers.
